name: Mihoshi Asuka
source: A classmate attending the same school as [url=/c133400]Hashigo[/url], and a girl on whom he used to have a crush. Because of her cheerful and friendly personality, she is considered an idol and is popular within the school. She is the president and representative of the women's archery club and seems to be busy running around everyday.
